rules.title: Rules
rules.introduction: Welcome to the official rules of the tournament. Please ensure you read and understand these guidelines before participating. These rules are designed to ensure fair play, sportsmanship, and an enjoyable experience for everyone involved.
rules.description1: All matches will be played in accordance with the official FIFA rules. This ensures consistency and fairness across all games. Players are expected to familiarize themselves with these rules before the tournament begins.
rules.description2: Each match will consist of two halves, with each half lasting 4 minutes of real-world time. There will be a 1-minute halftime break between the two halves. This rule is in place to maintain the pace of the game and provide players with a short rest.
rules.description3: Players must respect the decisions of the referee at all times. Disputes or disagreements with the referee’s decisions will not be tolerated. Any form of dissent, including verbal or physical abuse, will result in immediate penalties.
rules.description4: All participants are expected to maintain a high standard of sportsmanship. Any form of misconduct, including but not limited to foul language, aggressive behavior, or unsportsmanlike conduct, will result in penalties or disqualification from the tournament.
rules.description5: If a match is tied at the end of the regular time, there will be no extra time. The match will proceed directly to a penalty shootout to determine the winner. Each team will take five penalties, and if the scores remain level, the shootout will continue in a sudden-death format until a winner is decided.
rules.description6: In the event of an in-game bug or glitch, the referee will decide whether the match needs to be rewound or continued. This decision will be based on the severity of the issue and its impact on the fairness of the game. The referee’s decision is final.
rules.description7: Players who arrive more than 5 minutes after the scheduled match time will be disqualified. It is mandatory for all players to be present and ready at the start of the match. This rule ensures the smooth running of the tournament and fairness for all participants.
rules.description8: The spirit of fair play is at the heart of this tournament. Players are encouraged to compete with integrity, respect their opponents, and uphold the values of the game. Remember, it’s not just about winning—it’s about playing the game the right way.
rules.importantNotes: Failure to adhere to these rules may result in penalties, suspensions, or disqualification. The tournament organizers reserve the right to make final decisions on any disputes or rule interpretations.
rules.closingMessage: We wish all participants the best of luck and hope you enjoy the tournament. Let’s make this a memorable and exciting event for everyone!
